pages.text: The Rite of Broiling is an infernal cooking-working for turning dropped raw food into cooked meals all at once. It is efficient, dramatic, and never entirely gentle. A clever witch uses it when a camp full of meat needs preparing faster than any oven or campfire could manage.

In the live port this rite is started from a small infernal circle with $(item)Sugar$() as the trigger. From there it splits into two support paths. The ordinary branch needs $(item)Wood Ash$() and $(item)Coal$(), and it draws $(bold)1000 altar power$(/). The hotter branch needs $(item)Wood Ash$(), $(item)Blaze Powder$(), and a $(item)Charged Attuned Stone$(), returning the stone as a plain attuned one once the fire settles.

pages.title: Practical Use
pages.text: The ritual cooks every valid raw food stack lying in the flame's reach around the circle. If there is nothing raw to catch, the working now fizzles before the ordinary altar branch spends its strength. The stronger branch is harsher: some of what you offer will come back as $(item)Charcoal$() instead of supper. Cast it when you want speed, volume, and a little risk rather than perfect kitchen manners.
